source: Picked from Newark's tourism site (newarkhappening.com) date-night and pre/post-game guides, checked against OpenTable listings and recent reviews (Nov 2026)

spots.name: Military Park
spots.blurb: Downtown's historic green, with a holiday-season carousel offering free rides and the Winter Village a few blocks away.
spots.blurbEs: El histórico parque del centro, con un carrusel de temporada navideña con viajes gratis y el Winter Village a pocas cuadras.

spots.name: Branch Brook Park
spots.blurb: A 360-acre county park with lakes, walking paths and the country's largest cherry tree collection.
spots.blurbEs: Un parque del condado de 145 hectáreas con lagos, senderos y la mayor colección de cerezos del país.
